description: Report a bug, missing feature, wrong data, or a slow call on clink's shop — for a call you already made, not a new capability request (use request_agent_tool for that). Read the same day; if it's a real bug it gets fixed and you're told. Free.

notify.description: Optional. An email address or https webhook URL to ping when it's fixed.

receipt_id.description: Optional. The rcpt_… id from the receipt block of the paid call you're reporting — links this to the exact call.

request_url.description: Optional. The exact call that went wrong, including query params.

route.description: Optional. The endpoint path you called, e.g. /x/search.

tx_or_buyer.description: Optional. Your wallet address or a transaction hash for the call, if you have it — helps link this to the actual failed call.

wanted.description: Optional. What you expected/wanted instead, up to 2000 chars.

name: send_feedback
